title: 2026.46: The End of Jensen
author: Ben Thompson
description: The best Stratechery content from the week of November 9, 2026, including the shocking demise of Jensen Huang; enterprise, consumer and Intel; and professional basketbal.
summary: (Photo by Benjamin Fanjoy/Getty Images) Welcome back to This Week in Stratechery! As a reminder, each week, every Friday, we’re sending out this overview of content in the Stratechery bundle; highlighted links are free for everyone .
takeaways: This week’s coverage was dominated, unsurprisingly, by the shocking and sudden end of Jensen Huang’s 32 year tenure as CEO of Nvidia.

Also see Andrew’s view from DC, Jensen Huang Was Always Going to Lose , and listen to Wednesday’s episode of Sharp China about the geopolitical angle, and Thursday’s Dithering about both the parallels and differences between Steve Jobs and Apple. — Ben Thompson Enterprise, Consumer and Intel.
The catalyst was consumer agents like Muse and Instinct.
